title: console: the docs route /docs/NAME should show the candidate packages when the doc read answers 409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT (two enabled packages ship the name)
body:
domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUcj2x2Wr4UErwBi12

Filing gate: ② a UI follow-up a recorded ruling names. Filed by area S5 (E1b) for the ui lane, as ruling 6893582352 on #33264 requires.

## 维护者速读

- 问题：PR #34036 合并后，两个启用的包发布同名文档时，不指明包读取 `/meta/doc/NAME` 返回 409 并在响应里列出候选包。Console 的 `/docs/NAME` 页面需要把这些候选包显示出来，让用户点选某一个包的文档，而不是只显示一个笼统的错误。
- 优先级由分诊定。

## What is owed

Ruling 6893582352: "The Console `/docs/<name>` route must show the candidate packages on a 409: a UI-lane follow-up."

Acceptance:
- On a `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` from the doc read, the docs route lists the candidate packages named in the refusal.
- Each candidate opens that package's doc through its package address.
- Pin it in the docs-portal test harness (`ui/apps/console/src/pages/docs-portal.*.test.tsx`).
- CONTROL: one holder renders as today.

Depends on: PR #34036 (server refusal) merging. Note that #34040 tracks an exact `?package=` doc read on a composed artifact server answering the other holder's doc. The candidate links depend on that read answering right.

Prior rulings read: ruling 6893582352. client-sdk.mdx documents the `/meta` 409 holder list.

Dedupe: searched "docs 409 candidates Console" and found nothing.
